name: Frank DiMaggio
biography: is a manager of the Intel server team with a large insurance company in the South East. He has been in a systems administration role for over 18 years, working with small and medium sized businesses in North Florida. His experience is with Microsoft, Novell and Linux Operating Systems. In his spare time he contributes to open source security projects such as BASE, SamuraiWTF and Yokoso!
